description: Defines interval types and conversion functions for Resource Blocks (CRB, PRB, VRB) in a wireless communication context, including conversion between different resource block representations.

methods.name: crb_to_prb
methods.description: Converts a CRB index to a PRB index within specified limits.

methods.name: crb_to_prb
methods.description: Converts a CRB interval to a PRB interval within specified limits.

methods.name: prb_to_crb
methods.description: Converts a PRB index to a CRB index within specified limits.

methods.name: prb_to_crb
methods.description: Converts a PRB interval to a CRB interval within specified limits.

methods.name: crb_to_vrb_f1_0_common_ss_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a CRB interval to a VRB interval based on TS38.211, clause 7.3.1.6.
